Additional Equipment & Supplies

Beyond our core product lines, Blick stocks a range of equipment and consumables that keep drilling operations running smoothly. Every product below is available with local stock, competitive pricing, and the same technical support you expect from Blick.

Cutting Tools

Reamer parts & cutting components

Replacement cutters and wear parts for HDD reamers and downhole tools. Melfred Borzall originals and Blick-supplied alternatives.

Melfred Borzall

Shark Tooth Cutters

Ultra hard, abrasion-resistant carbide cutters for HDD reamers. Available in mini, small, medium, and large sizes to match common reamer configurations. Keeps your reamers cutting when it counts.

Site Equipment

On-site tools & accessories

Essential equipment for HDD, geotech, and waterwell operations — from tracking systems to mud management and pipe handling.

Grundomat

Pneumatic Piercing Tools

The Grundomat® piercing tool performs accurate bores up to 30 metres in a wide range of conditions. Compressed air drives a piston against the chisel head assembly, creating a pilot bore then expanding to target diameter. 16 models from 45P to 180P.

Melfred Borzall

Rod Wipers

Keep drill mud out of carriages, reducing mess and wear on moving parts. Available in solid, single split, and dual split configurations. Sizes to suit all common Ditch Witch, Vermeer, and Astec/Toro rig and rod combinations.

Sondes & Batteries

Reconditioned DigiTrak sondes (Eclipse, SE, F2, F5, Falcon) with 100-day warranty exceeding factory standards. Plus lithium sonde batteries, locator batteries, and chargers. Every transmitter is shock, vibration, and thermal resistance tested.
